adapter.name: b1b
adapter.description: B1b: PostgreSQL full-text search + pgvector cosine fused by reciprocal rank (k=60); access pre-filters ON; every result revalidated against the stores under the case's AccessContext

read_side_effects.note: MemoryStore.recall writes last_accessed on every read; the store fingerprint excludes it. A retrieval path that must be read-only (shadow mode) needs a read that does not stamp.
